findings.desc: CHK-002:adversarial:0 intent requires demonstrating the selfcheck exits with code 1 when an assertion fails, but the bound evidence command (node experiments/recovery-runner/make-fig-gate-ablation-selfcheck.mjs) only runs the passing selfcheck (exits 0 with 38 assertions passed). The note says the exit-1 path was implementer-verified by manually breaking an assertion, which is not reproducible by re-running the bound command. A runnable one-liner that injects a deliberate failure (e.g. node -e "..." or a temp fixture) and asserts exit code 1 would properly bind this intent.
findings.resolvedReason: Reproducible exit-1 self-test added (commit f17c76f0): normal run self-spawns a child with FIG_SELFCHECK_FORCE_FAIL=1 and asserts child.status===1; FIG_SELFCHECK_FORCE_FAIL=1 node selfcheck exits 1 (verified). Selfcheck now 43 assertions, run-selfchecks 8/8.

findings.desc: codex host-2 (cross-vendor): make-fig-gate-ablation.mjs dedups keep-first by arm|taskId|scenarioId|repeat; analyze.mjs keeps every valid non-void row (no cell-key dedup). On the SAME raw powered/*.jsonl the generator reports 9240 cells (A4 2/1920) while analyze-style counting sees 18557 rows (A4 4/3855). INVESTIGATION: raw set = 18557 records = 9240 unique cells each run ~2x (max 3x) across session-limit re-runs; 0 duplicated cells have conflicting outcomes, so the deduped 9240 figure is unambiguous and CORRECT (matches the paper analysis run on deduped input per the known analyze-needs-dedup-first requirement). Real cross-tool CONSISTENCY HAZARD + missing dedup transparency, not a wrong figure. Fix in scope: generator prints dedup transparency (raw->unique->dropped + conflict count) + a conflict guard (error if any duplicated cell has conflicting outcomes); README documents figure and analyze both operate on the deduped cell matrix and analyze must dedup raw input first. analyze.mjs itself is out of scope (locked).
findings.resolvedReason: Dedup transparency + conflict guard added (commit f17c76f0): readRecordsWithStats exposes rawCount/uniqueCount/droppedCount; run() prints 'dedup: 18557 raw records -> 9240 unique cells (9317 duplicate re-runs dropped)'; a hard conflict guard throws if any duplicated cell has conflicting adjudicatedOutcome (0 in the real data -> 9240 unambiguous+correct, matches the paper's deduped analysis). README documents figure & analyze both operate on the deduped cell matrix and analyze must dedup raw input first. analyze.mjs (no dedup) is out of scope/locked; flagged for the analysis/paper workstream.
